150485643.reason: Repeatedly rescans balance and palindrome candidates from scratch, yielding quadratic work on long same-bracket suffixes. On 0008 times out; no wrong numeric answer is available at the recorded test.

150493146.reason: For each unmatched opening after an initial closing bracket, searches again to the end for a closing bracket. The final long unremovable suffix of 0023 causes quadratic work and TLE, with only a correct output prefix captured.

150494803.reason: The palindrome comparison while(c[li]==c[ri]) lacks an li<=ri boundary. Its recorded 0014 outcome is TLE rather than a wrong answer; potential undefined behaviour is not substituted for an observed valid wrong answer.

150496314.reason: Independent if statements mutate i and then inspect a later segment in the same iteration; a[i+1] also extends past n and can contain stale prior-case data. On 0006 counts 3 operations/0 remaining for (())( instead of 2/1.

150497749.reason: Accesses a[i+1] past the current string and reuses stale data from previous cases, consuming an unmatched trailing bracket. On 0006 counts 2 operations/0 remaining for (()( instead of 1/2.
